faq.description: Answers about pricing, trials, data security, payroll compliance and support.
faq.stillQuestions: Still have questions? We're happy to help.

items.q: Is the software available in Tamil?
items.a: Yes. The whole application — including the employee self-service app — can be used in Tamil or English, and each user can switch at any time.

items.q: How long is the free trial?
items.a: Most plans include a 14-day free trial with full features. No credit card is required to start.

items.q: Does it handle PF, ESI and professional tax?
items.a: Yes. The Business plan and above include statutory deductions for PF, ESI and Tamil Nadu professional tax, with the standard reports.

items.q: Can I use biometric attendance devices?
items.a: The Growth plan supports integration with common biometric devices. Our team will confirm compatibility with your device model during the demo.

items.q: Where is my data stored and is it secure?
items.a: Data is stored in secure cloud infrastructure with encryption in transit, daily backups and strict separation between companies. Only people you authorise can see your data.
You can pay by bank transfer or UPI. Online card payment will be added later. Each payment is confirmed by our accounts team before it is shown as received.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how {{brand}} collects, uses and protects personal information when you use our website, customer portal and services.

p: Details you give us in forms — such as your name, company, phone number, email and city — and information about your company account and subscription.
Technical information such as browser type and pages visited. Analytics cookies are only used if you accept them.
To respond to enquiries, schedule demos, provide the service, send transactional messages and improve our products.
We contact you by phone, email or WhatsApp only with your consent. You can withdraw consent at any time, including by replying STOP on WhatsApp.
We do not sell personal information. We use trusted service providers (hosting, email delivery, messaging) who process data on our behalf under contract.
Data is encrypted in transit and each customer's data is isolated from others. We keep information only as long as needed for the purposes above or as required by law.
You can ask to access, correct or delete your personal information by contacting us. Customer company administrators can manage their users from the portal.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of {{brand}}'s website, customer portal and HRMS subscription services.

p: You are responsible for keeping your login details secure and for activity under your company account. Administrators are responsible for the users they invite.
Trials give access to the selected plan for the stated period. At the end of the trial the account is paused until a paid plan is chosen.
Fees are shown in Indian Rupees and are exclusive of GST. A payment is treated as received only after it has been confirmed by our accounts team or our payment provider.
Unpaid renewals may lead to suspension after a grace period.
You can cancel at any time. Paid periods are not refunded unless required by law; the service remains available until the period ends.
Do not misuse the service, attempt to access other customers' data, or send messages without the recipient's consent.
The service is provided with reasonable care and skill. Our total liability is limited to the fees paid in the previous three months.

whatsapp.setupTitle: Connect the official WhatsApp Cloud API
setupSteps: Create a Meta Business account and a Meta developer app with the WhatsApp product.
Add and verify your business phone number in WhatsApp Manager.
Create a permanent System User access token with whatsapp_business_messaging permission.
Set META_WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN, META_WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID, META_WHATSAPP_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT_ID, META_WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN and META_APP_SECRET in Netlify, then redeploy.
In the Meta app's WhatsApp → Configuration, set the callback URL shown here and the same verify token, and subscribe to the messages field.
Create message templates (demo_confirmation, demo_reminder, …) in WhatsApp Manager and wait for approval.
Switch on Cloud API messaging in Settings once templates are approved.
whatsapp.costNote: Business-initiated template messages may be charged by Meta per conversation. Messages are only sent to contacts who opted in, and sending is off until you enable it.

att.noRecordBody: Ask your HR team to add you as an employee with your email address.
att.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Forgot to check out, client visit
att.correctNote: Corrections are recorded with your name and the time of change.
att.clearConfirm: The day goes back to its automatic status (absent, leave, holiday…).
att.rangeTooLong: Choose a range of up to {{days}} days, with the start before the end.
att.truncated: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}} rows. Export CSV to get them all.

leave.title: Leave
leave.subtitle: Your leave balance and requests.
leave.subtitleHr: Approve requests, see everyone's leave and set leave types and holidays.
leave.applySubtitle: Choose the leave type and dates. Weekly offs and holidays are not counted.
leave.withdrawConfirm: Your pending request will be withdrawn.
leave.previewNone: No working days in these dates (weekly offs and holidays are excluded).
leave.typesHint: Yearly quota per employee. Leave the quota empty for no limit (e.g. Loss of Pay).
leave.holidaysHint: Company holidays are skipped when counting leave and attendance.
leave.noHolidays: No holidays added for this year
leave.forwardedToast: Approved and sent to HR for the final decision
leave.rulesHint: How this leave is earned, carried over and approved. Changes apply to new requests.
leave.quotaHint: Days per employee per year. Leave empty for no limit.

accrualHints.annual: The whole year's quota is available from the start of the year.
accrualHints.monthly: 1/12 of the quota is added each month (from the joining month in the first year).

leave.carryForwardHint: Unused days from last year that move to this year. 0 = no carry-forward.
leave.maxHoursHint: Leave empty for no monthly limit.
leave.compOffRules: Balance comes from approved comp-off credits. Each credit expires 90 days after the day worked and is used oldest first.

levelHints.1: The reporting manager or HR approves.
levelHints.2: The reporting manager approves first, then HR gives the final decision.

leave.typesHintV2: Set how each leave type is earned and approved. Use “Rules” for accrual, carry-forward and approval levels.
leave.compOffApplyHint: Comp-off is taken one day (or half day) at a time and uses your oldest credit first.
leave.previewHoursNone: Choose a start and end time.
leave.twoLevelNote: Your manager approves first, then HR.
leave.cancelApprovedConfirm: Cancel the approved leave of {{name}} ({{dates}})? The days go back to their balance.

reg.title: Request attendance correction
reg.subtitle: Forgot to check in or out, or worked from outside? Ask HR to correct the day.
reg.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Phone battery died, worked 9:00 to 6:00 at the client site
reg.approveNote: Approving updates that day’s attendance record. It never creates a second record for the same day.

shifts.title: Shifts & roster
shifts.subtitle: Shift timings, weekly rotations and who works when.
shifts.rosterHint: Change a single day here (shift swap or extra day off). “As planned” goes back to the rotation or fixed shift. Weekly offs come from each employee’s profile.
shifts.name: Shift name
shifts.codeHint: Shown on the roster, e.g. M, E, N
shifts.breakHint: Deducted from days of 5 hours or more
shifts.earlyGraceHint: Leaving earlier than this is marked “left early”
shifts.overtimeAfterHint: Extra minutes beyond the shift before overtime starts
shifts.formSubtitle: An end time earlier than the start time means the shift ends the next day.
shifts.noShiftsBody: Create shifts such as 09:00–18:00, 18:00–01:00 and 01:00–09:00, then rotate them weekly.
shifts.rotationSubtitle: Employees move to the next shift every week, then the cycle repeats.
shifts.firstWeekHint: Weeks start on Monday — week 1 begins {{date}}
shifts.rotationExplain: After week {{weeks}} the rotation starts again from week 1.
shifts.noRotationsBody: A rotation moves people through shifts week by week, e.g. Morning → Evening → Night.
shifts.deleteRotationBody: Employees on this rotation go back to their default shift. Past attendance is not changed.
shifts.assignSubtitle: Put employees on a fixed shift or a weekly rotation from a date.
shifts.untilHint: Leave empty to keep it running
shifts.endAssignmentBody: The employee goes back to their default shift from today. Past attendance is not changed.
shifts.noAssignmentsBody: Without an assignment, each employee uses the shift timing on their profile.

alerts.title: Requires attention
alerts.allClearBody: Nothing needs HR action right now.
alerts.footnote: Alerts are worked out live from attendance, leave and employee records. Resolved alerts do not come back; snoozed ones return on the chosen date.

reason.missing_punch: Checked in at {{time}} on {{date}} but never checked out.
reason.not_checked_in: Shift started at {{time}}; no check-in and no approved leave.
reason.repeated_late: Late {{count}} times in the last 30 days ({{minutes}} min in total).
reason.leave_conflict: Checked in on {{date}} while on approved leave.

action.missing_punch: Confirm the check-out time with the employee and correct the day.
action.not_checked_in: Check with the employee or their manager; mark leave if they are off.
action.repeated_late: Review their attendance and discuss timing with them.
action.excess_hours: Confirm the overtime was approved and check workload.
action.leave_conflict: Cancel the leave or correct the attendance so payroll is right.
action.pending_leave: Approve or reject the leave request.
action.pending_regularization: Approve or reject the correction request.
action.contract_expiry: Decide on renewal and update the contract end date.
action.probation_end: Complete the probation review and confirm the employee.
action.incomplete_profile: Fill in the missing details on the employee profile.
action.pending_document: Open the document and approve or reject it.

e360.heatmapLabel: Attendance for the last 12 weeks, one square per day
e360.noReports: No one reports to this person.
e360.noAttendance: No attendance in the last 12 weeks
e360.inviteSent: Invitation sent to {{email}} — they can set their password from the email

compOff.title: Comp-off credits
compOff.hint: Worked on a weekly off or holiday? Ask for a comp-off day to take later.
compOff.requestHint: Choose the off day or holiday you worked. Your attendance for that day must be recorded.

persona.title: Continue as
persona.subtitle: {{email}} has more than one account type. Choose how you want to use the portal now.
persona.switchLater: You can switch any time from your name at the top right.

desc.admin: Company, billing, branding, users and all HR
desc.hr: Employees, attendance, shifts and leave approvals
desc.employee: Mark your attendance, apply for leave, see your balance

payroll.title: Payroll
payroll.subtitle: Monthly salaries with LOP from attendance, PF, ESI, professional tax and payslips.
payroll.finalizeConfirm: Lock payroll for {{month}}? Employees will then see their payslips and you can email them.
payroll.reopenConfirm: Reopen this month for corrections? Employees stop seeing these payslips until you finalize again.
payroll.emailConfirmAll: Send payslips to all {{count}} employees from your SMTP email?
payroll.emailConfirmSome: Send payslips to the {{count}} selected employees?
payroll.emailedSome: {{sent}} sent, {{failed}} not sent (check the Email column)
payroll.missingTitle_one: {{count}} active employee has no salary set and will be left out
payroll.missingTitle_other: {{count}} active employees have no salary set and will be left out
payroll.noRunBody: Choose “Run payroll” to calculate salaries from attendance and leave.
payroll.noSlipsBody: Set salary structures for your employees, then recalculate.
payroll.salaryHint: Monthly amounts. A revision applies from its date; earlier months keep the old salary.
payroll.effectiveHint: Usually the 1st of a month or the joining date.
payroll.esiApplies: Deduct ESI (when gross is within the ESI limit)
payroll.previewHint: Full month without LOP. Professional tax shown as a monthly average.
payroll.defaultsNote: These are the standard rules (PF 12% up to ₹15,000, ESI 0.75% / 3.25% up to ₹21,000 gross, Tamil Nadu PT). Change them if your company differs, then save.
payroll.pfCap: Calculate PF only up to the ceiling
payroll.esiLimitHint: Employees with monthly gross above this are not covered.
payroll.ptHint: Tax for each half year by half-yearly income. Half years: April–September and October–March.

ptFreqHint.half_yearly: Full half-year tax in September and March salaries.
ptFreqHint.monthly: One sixth of the half-year tax every month.

payroll.employerContrib: Employer contribution (not deducted from you): PF {{pf}} · ESI {{esi}}
payroll.systemGenerated: This is a system-generated payslip and needs no signature.
payroll.mySubtitle: Your monthly payslips. Open one to view or print it.
payroll.myNoneBody: Payslips appear here after HR finalizes the month's payroll.
payroll.encashHint: How the amount per encashed day is worked out when HR approves a request.

encash.title: Leave encashment
encash.hint: Cash out unused leave days. HR approves, and the amount is paid in the next payroll.
encash.requestHint: Encashed days come off this year's balance. The amount is worked out from your salary when HR approves.
encash.nextPayroll: Will be paid in the next payroll
encash.canTake: You can encash up to {{count}} days
encash.maxDaysHint: Leave empty for no limit (the balance still applies).

docs.title: Documents
docs.uploadHint: PDF or photo, up to 5 MB. Only you and your HR team can see it.
docs.uploadedPending: Uploaded — waiting for HR to approve
docs.uploadFailed: The file could not be uploaded.
docs.fileRules: PDF, JPG, PNG or WebP · up to 5 MB

errors.type: Only PDF, JPG, PNG or WebP files are allowed.
errors.size: The file is larger than 5 MB.

docs.expiresHint: Optional. HR is reminded 30 days before.
docs.noneBody: Upload ID proofs, letters and certificates here.
docs.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{title}}” and its file? This cannot be undone.
docs.mySubtitle: Your ID proofs, letters and certificates.

helpdesk.subtitle: Ask HR about pay, leave, policies and more.
helpdesk.askHint: Only you and your HR team can see this.
helpdesk.subject: Subject
helpdesk.internalHint: Internal note (the employee cannot see it)
helpdesk.closedNote: This ticket is closed. Open a new one if you still need help.
helpdesk.articleHint: Policies and how-to answers your staff can read.

assets.addHint: Each asset needs its own tag number.
assets.name: Name
assets.tagTaken: Another asset already uses this tag.
assets.noneBody: Add the items your company lends to staff.
assets.noneHeld: No company assets with this person.

delegation.title: Approval delegation
delegation.hint: While a manager is away, a colleague approves their team's leave and comp-off. Nobody can approve their own requests.
delegation.limitsHint: When waiting approvals are emailed to HR, and when Company Admins are told.

workforce.title: Workforce analytics
workforce.subtitle: Headcount, turnover, attendance, leave and salary cost.

mfa.title: Security
mfa.subtitle: Protect your account.
mfa.offBody: After your password, you also enter a 6-digit code from an app on your phone (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or similar).
mfa.onBody: A code from your authenticator app is asked each time you sign in.
mfa.turnOffConfirm: Your account will be protected by the password only.
mfa.scan: 1. Scan this code with your authenticator app. 2. Enter the 6-digit code it shows.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
mfa.manual: Can't scan? Type this key into the app:
mfa.wrongCode: That code didn't work. Try the newest one.
mfa.setupFailed: Could not start set-up. Please try again.
mfa.challengeHint: Open your authenticator app and type the 6-digit code.
mfa.lostPhone: Lost your phone? Ask your administrator to reset two-step sign-in.
mfa.devicesBody: Sign out everywhere else, for example after using a shared computer.
